reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(a.impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 3
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
), rates AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT spend_date, clicks, impressions,
    100.0 * SUM(clicks) OVER (ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
      / SUM(impressions) OVER (ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ctr_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT spend_date, clicks, impressions, ROUND(ctr_7d, 2) AS ctr_7d_pct
FROM rates
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(a.impressions) AS impressions
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 3
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.spend_date, d.clicks, d.impressions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(p.clicks) / SUM(p.impressions), 2) AS ctr_7d_pct
FROM daily d
JOIN daily p ON p.spend_date BETWEEN d.spend_date - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND d.spend_date
WHERE d.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
GROUP BY d.spend_date, d.clicks, d.impressions
